tools.name: get_weather_forecast
tools.description: Daily weather forecast for a point. day is 0-based: day 0 is the first forecast day, the day after the GFS run date (UTC), not today. forecast_dates in the response lists all available days (currently 6 or 7 depending on the model run). tools.name: get_historical_climate
tools.description: 10-year historical climate averages (2015-2024, ERA5 reanalysis) for a point. Pass month 1-12 for that month's climatology with min and max ranges: accumulations (precipitation, snowfall, evaporation, radiation) are then totals for that month, for example precipitation_mm in mm/month. Omit month for

tools.name: get_climate_timeseries
tools.description: Monthly time series 2015-2025 (about 130 monthly values) for one variable at a point, plus the 12-month climatology. Accumulation variables are monthly totals: precipitation_mm and total_evaporation_mm in mm/month (evaporation positive), snowfall_cm in cm/month, net_solar_radiation_mj_m2 and net_the

tools.name: get_terrain
tools.description: Terrain for a point: elevation (m), slope and aspect (degrees) at 30 m resolution (Copernicus DEM), plus Topographic Wetness Index (flood susceptibility indicator).

tools.name: get_hazards
tools.description: Natural hazard indices for a point: Fire Weather Index (current danger), soil erosion risk (RUSLE, t/ha/yr), and flood susceptibility (Topographic Wetness Index).

tools.name: get_environment
tools.description: Environmental data for a point: NDVI vegetation index (300 m), annual evapotranspiration (MODIS, mm/year), and ESA WorldCover land cover class.

tools.name: get_soil
tools.description: Soil properties at a point from SoilGrids 2.0 (ISRIC - World Soil Information, CC BY 4.0), 250 m mean predictions: clay, sand and silt (%), bulk density, coarse fragments, organic carbon (content, density and 0-30 cm stock), total nitrogen, cation exchange capacity and pH, at six depths from 0-5 cm

tools.name: get_proximity
tools.description: Straight-line distance in km from a point to the nearest feature of six layers: coastline, highway (motorway or trunk road), airport (large or medium), major port, hospital or clinic, and school. Each layer is returned with its display name and distance_km.

tools.name: get_polygon_stats
tools.description: Aggregate statistics (mean, min, max, std) over a polygon area: weather, terrain, hazards, environment, soil, and population. Coordinates are [longitude, latitude] pairs forming a simple ring (no self-intersections). Maximum area depends on plan (free tier: 100 km2, measured on the sphere). Weather
